origin.description: Paste two character vectors with no separator.
origin.details: The lengths must match, or one of them must be 1. If either argument has length 0, the result has length 0. A length-1 argument is recycled.
origin.example:
cat("foo" %+% "bar", "
", sep="")
cat(paste(letters[1:10] %+% chr(1:10), collapse=" "), "
", sep="")
cat(if (length(character() %+% "*") == 0) "character(0)
")

translation.description: Paste two character vectors with no separator.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: A str, or a list of strings. A str has length 1.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A str, or a list of strings.

translation.details: This is %+%. A str is not iterated character by character. An empty list on either side returns an empty list.
translation.value: The concatenated string, or a list of strings.
translation.example:
print(concat("foo", "bar"))
print(" ".join(concat(list("abcdefghij"), [str(i) for i in range(1, 11)])))
print("character(0)" if concat([], "*") == [] else concat([], "*"))
